newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco 11-month sales up 11.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Meralco 11-month sales up 11.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Manila Electric Co (Meralco), the country's biggest electricity distributor, said on Thursday its sales rose 11.6 percent to 16.336 billion kilowatt-hours (kwh) compared to the same period last year.
In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, Meralco said its sales to all customer categories rose for the 11-month period.

Sales to residential customers posted the biggest increase of 12.2 percent followed by commercial establishments by 11.9 percent. Industries registered an 11 percent rise in sales from January to November this year.
For the month of November alone, Meralco sales reached 1.56 billion kwh, 17 percent more than sales in November 1995.
